bullets.text: Sunak Joins Microsoft, Anthropic - **Rishi Sunak** takes on advisory roles amid concerns over AI regulation influence.
Google's Special Market Status - **CMA** designates **Google** for stricter regulations in online search and advertising.
Google's Search Operations Under Review - New regulations may alter how **Google** operates in the UK search market.
Apple Vision Pro's Game-Changer - Live **NBA** games to be streamed in immersive video on **Apple Vision Pro**.
Emergency SOS Expansion - **Apple** to launch Emergency SOS via satellite in **Mexico** later this year.
Deloitte's AI Commitment - Despite a $10M refund, **Deloitte** rolls out **Anthropic's** AI to all employees.
OpenAI's Controversial Tactics - **OpenAI** allegedly intimidates AI regulation advocates with subpoenas.
Google Chrome's Notification Silence - New feature will mute notifications from inactive websites in **Chrome**.
